newsitem.title: UK: UK's Heseltine attacks pro-Labour business report.
newsitem.headline: UK's Heseltine attacks pro-Labour business report.

text.p: Deputy Prime Minister Michael Heseltine launched a fierce attack on Tuesday on a group of businessmen who produced a report backing many of the opposition Labour Party's economic policies.
Heseltine criticised the report, commissioned by the left-leaning Institute for Public Policy and Research, for giving the government insufficient credit for reviving the British economy.
He rejected the group's argument that deregulation and privatisation had largely run their course and said they were naive to support a minimum wage and the European Social Chapter.
